host: a second workstation; one NVIDIA H100 (80 GB), driver 580.178.04; up to four runs at a time on that accelerator

check_cell.what: one cell of the first cohort (patient fold 0, reaction fold 0, own-expression arm, training seed 2024) rerun twice on the second workstation, outside the plan

deviations: The runs were made on a second workstation, because both accelerators of the first were in use by another service. The accelerator model and the versions of PyTorch, CUDA, cuDNN and PyTorch Geometric are the same; the Python interpreter is 3.12.3 in place of 3.10.12.

The driver is the released code/double_holdout_ctrl.py, byte-identical to the file that ran the first cohort. The released code/trainer.py differs from the file that ran the first cohort in comments, docstrings and log messages only.
The jobs ran at a lowered scheduling priority (nice 5), which does not enter any computation.
One cell of the first cohort was rerun twice on the second workstation as a check of the environment, outside the plan; its results are in this record and in no analysis.
